prompt: Write a harbor mystery about a hidden cargo manifest.
title: The Last Manifest
logline: A dock clerk asks an outsider to recover a manifest and decide whether truth or family safety should own it.

setting.summary: Harbor Ward survives on diverted cargo, night inspections, and favors traded beneath the sodium lamps. Low Tide Cafe is Mara's public workplace and private dead drop; Harbor Archive is the only institution able to publish a signed shipping record.

characters.name: Mara Voss
characters.background: Mara has recorded every diverted shipment since her brother disappeared on the night shift.
characters.want: She wants the manifest made public without exposing her remaining family.
characters.voice: She speaks in clipped inventory terms until grief breaks the list apart.

presentation.heading: A missing line

scene.description: Mara closes the till while inspectors cross the wet loading yard outside. She leaves one invoice open between them, its seventh line cut away.

presentation.action: Mara explains that one cargo line vanished with her brother.

dialogue.line: Six crates arrived. The ledger says five. My brother was standing where the missing one should be.

presentation.consequence: The player knows the manifest can name who ordered the diversion.

development.heading: Under the counter

scene.description: A loose panel beneath the service counter hides a folded manifest stamped with the harbor authority's seal and signed in fresh blue ink.

development.action: The player finds the signed manifest where Mara hid it during the raid.
development.consequence: Possession makes the evidence usable and puts Mara at risk.

conflict.heading: Who owns the truth

scene.description: Freight sirens cover Mara's warning while the archive lights burn across the canal. Both destinations remain reachable, but only until the shift changes.

conflict.action: Mara admits the archive will publish the evidence but a quiet return will protect her family.

dialogue.line: Give them the page and they print his name. Give it back and my mother sees morning.

conflict.consequence: The player must choose public accountability or immediate safety.

ending.heading: The next tide

scene.description: The archive shutters rise as Mara waits across the canal. The manifest can enter public record or disappear into her private ledger, and each act closes the other route.

ending.action: The destination chosen for the manifest determines Mara's future.
ending.consequence: One ending exposes the diversion; the other preserves the family and buries the record.

decisions.setup: The recovered manifest can go to the public archive or back to Mara.

options.consequence: The diversion becomes public and Mara must leave the harbor.

options.choice: Return to Mara and keep it quiet.
options.consequence: Her family stays safe while the diversion remains hidden.
